title: Approvals
subtitle: Correction requests waiting for your decision, and the ones already decided.

inbox.emptyHint: Requests assigned to you, your role or your branches appear here.
inbox.ownRequestHint: You cannot approve or reject your own request. Cancel it from Corrections instead.

decided.emptyHint: Approved, applied, rejected and cancelled corrections appear here.

decision.approveHint: The next step is notified; on the final step the correction is applied and the day recomputed.
decision.rejectHint: The requester sees your comment as the rejection reason.
decision.commentRequired: A comment is required when rejecting.
decision.stepApproved: Step approved — waiting for the next approver

workflows.title: Approval workflows
workflows.subtitle: Who approves corrections, in which order. The branch-specific default wins over the organisation default; without any workflow, requesters with the approve permission are auto-approved and others go to HR admins.
workflows.dialogHint: Up to 5 ordered steps. MANAGER resolves to the employee's manager (falls back to HR admin).
workflows.branchScopeHint: Leave empty for an organisation-wide workflow.
workflows.isDefaultHint: Used automatically for new requests in its scope.
workflows.managerHint: The employee's manager decides this step.
workflows.emptyHint: Without a workflow, corrections from users who can approve are applied immediately; others go to HR admins.
workflows.deleteHint: Pending requests already routed through this workflow keep their steps.
